I'm working in the DeliveryHub frontend/backend repos (frontend: C:\Users\jotac\OneDrive\Documents\DEV\deliveryhub_white_label, backend: C:\Users\jotac\OneDrive\Documents\DEV\serer_delivery, NestJS + Supabase). Pure research — do NOT modify any files, just report findings with exact file paths and line numbers.

I need to add a notification badge (red bubble with a number) on the "Delivery" nav item — both in the restaurant owner's top header favorites bar and in the sidebar (`RestauranteSidebar.jsx`) — that shows a count of NEW delivery orders that just arrived and need attention. This mirrors an existing pattern already in the codebase for "Motoboys" pending affiliation requests: a hook `useSolicitacoesMotoboyCount` (in `src/hooks/useSolicitacoesMotoboyCount.js`) polls `GET /api/restaurante/motoboys/solicitacoes/count` every 30s, and `RestauranteHeader.jsx`/`RestauranteSidebar.jsx`/`MobileMenu.jsx` render a small red badge next to the "Motoboys" label when the count is > 0.

Please research and report:

1. Read `src/hooks/useSolicitacoesMotoboyCount.js` in full — show its exact implementation so I can copy the pattern exactly (polling interval, how it handles errors, what it returns).

2. Read the backend endpoint it calls (`restaurante-motoboys.controller.ts` `solicitacoes/count`, and `motoboy.service.ts`'s `contarSolicitacoesPendentes` — I recall this from earlier, but confirm current exact code) so I understand the count-endpoint pattern used elsewhere in this codebase.

3. Find how "new delivery order" is defined elsewhere in the app — what order status represents "just arrived, restaurant hasn't acknowledged yet"? Look at `restaurante-delivery/index.jsx` (the Delivery order-management page) and `restaurante-dashboard` for any existing badge, sound alert, or "novo pedido" notification logic (I know from prior work in this codebase that `restaurante-cozinha/index.jsx` and `restaurante-producao/index.jsx` already play a sound via `useNotificacaoSonora` when new items/orders arrive — check what STATUS these consider "new": is it `status === 'pending'` (unconfirmed) specifically, or `status === 'confirmed'`?). Also check `restaurante-dashboard/index.jsx` for any existing "pedidos pendentes"/"novo pedido" count or badge already shown somewhere (e.g. a KPI card) — I want to know if there's already a backend endpoint returning a count of pending/unconfirmed delivery orders for a restaurant that I could reuse instead of writing a new one.

4. Find the exact current content of `RestauranteHeader.jsx`, `RestauranteSidebar.jsx`, and `MobileMenu.jsx` (`src/components/restaurante/`) — specifically the parts showing the Motoboys badge (I know the sidebar renders `{l.path === '/restaurante/motoboys' && pendentesMotoboy > 0 && (...)}` inline in the button, and the header's favorites-bar icon strip has a similar absolute-positioned badge added recently for Motoboys) — show these exact blocks so I can replicate the same code shape for the Delivery link (`l.path === '/restaurante/delivery'`).

5. Find `src/config/restauranteNavLinks.js` and confirm the exact path/label used for the Delivery link (I recall `{ label: 'Delivery', path: '/restaurante/delivery', icon: 'Truck' }` inside `DELIVERY_LINKS`).

Report concisely: exact code snippets and file paths for all 5 points above, plus your recommendation on which order status should count as "new pedido" needing the badge (based on what pattern is already established in this codebase for "needs restaurant attention").
